messages:
maggie: FYI StrataTel just flagged a 10x token delta between their daily dashboard and the invoice for 2026-02-28. Dashboard shows ~12k tokens, invoice charged ~120k. They're asking for an explanation and a provisional credit.

jason: account id? any replication steps or logs from our side?

maggie: acct: strata-001. Attached the usage query I ran against the ledger and the raw ingest log from the collector. Seems like repeated POSTs around 00:12 UTC.

maggie: usage snippet:
```json
{"date":"2026-02-28","source":"ingest","tokens_reported":120450,"tokens_ui":12412}
```

maggie: collector log (redacted):
```
2026-02-28T00:12:01Z POST /v1/streams/ingest 200 id=abc123
2026-02-28T00:12:02Z POST /v1/streams/ingest 200 id=abc123
2026-02-28T00:12:03Z POST /v1/streams/ingest 200 id=abc123
```

alyssa: that repeating id pattern looks like a client-side retry loop with no dedupe key. Do we dedupe on id?

jason: our ingestion dedupe works when idempotency_key is provided. If clients retry without idempotency, we count each event. Could be SDK bug where reconnects triggered immediate resend without idempotency.

maggie: customer says they were on our JS SDK v1.4.1 and had a background job that streamed embeddings. They saw intermittent socket resets from the network.

alyssa: possible repro: simulate intermittent 500s then immediate client retry without exponential backoff + missing idempotency. Can we check ingestion service metrics for repeated event ids for that account?

maggie: I queried ingestion.events with filter account=strata-001 and id=abc123 and saw 318 duplicate rows between 00:12 and 00:18.

jason: that explains the ~10x delta. Next steps: offer provisional credit immediately, create ledger adjustment, and file a bug for SDK retry behavior and update docs to recommend idempotency_key for streaming jobs.

emma_finance: please propose provisional credit amount. Also need a revrec reason string and ticket id for Finance reconciliation.

maggie: proposing provisional credit = billed_amount - expected_amount. Bill was $1,245.00, expected based on UI ~ $124.50 -> credit $1,120.50. I'll round to $1,121.

emma_finance: OK provisionally approve $1,121. Create a ledger credit with note: "Provisional refund for duplicate ingestion - pending SDK fix. Support thread 2198765432." Tag GL code: REV-MISC-2026.

billing-bot: Created provisional credit id=pc-20260228-879, amount=1121.00, status=PENDING. Ledger ref: L-20260228-890.

maggie: pinging @jason to open SDK issue and add tests for socket reconnect path. Also adding an internal playbook so support can triage similar tickets quickly.

jason: will open github issue and link to support thread. Quick mitigation: advise customers to set idempotency_key on streaming uploads and implement exponential backoff on reconnect. Add note to release notes and docs.

alyssa: for the playbook item, recommend we run a dashboard daily job that flags >3 identical event ids in 15m window per account and auto-generate a support alert.

emma_finance: once we have the ledger adjustment and the support ticket, Finance will convert provisional credit to final after root-cause verification. Please include unit test evidence or SDK PR link.

maggie: final status update: provisional credit issued (pc-20260228-879), bug filed #sdk-retry-214, docs PR linked. Customer notified and accepted provisional credit; awaiting final revrec conversion.

jason: assigning postmortem to eng-runtime to evaluate dedupe hooks in ingest path and consider server-side ingest dedupe by default for streams older than 30s.

maggie: closing loop here. TL;DR playbook we used: 1) Verify duplicate event ids, 2) Query ledger for token delta, 3) Propose provisional credit calc, 4) Create provisional credit with revrec note & GL code, 5) File SDK bug and mitigation guidance, 6) Convert provisional credit on validation. Keeping thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
